name: Alphalete - Project Guide
body:
> Guide · Alphalete · 2026-10-01

# Summary
The `CLAUDE.md` project guide for the Alphalete folder (rewritten Oct 1 2026 after the file reorganization). It covers client basics, site and tool access, 17 standing rules, recurring workflows and key IDs. The rules are summarized in [Alphalete - Decisions and Rules](lib:brain-alphalete-decisions-and-rules); this note keeps the access, workflow and ID reference.

# Site and tool access (references only)
- SSH alias `alphalete`; WP root `~/domains/alphaletetrenchless.com/public_html`; wp-cli as `--user=3`; site timezone UTC.
- Repo `alphalete-trenchless-website/` (remotes `origin` = Agency owner, `mine` = user). mu-plugin source of truth: `mu-plugins/alphalete-seo-helpers.php`. See [Alphalete - Website Repo and mu-plugins](lib:brain-alphalete-website-repo-and-mu-plugins).
- SEO head = MetaSync/OTTO, project `5c619c90-4086-48ad-afb7-943f3b912546`. OTTO crawl frequency is "Never", so new URLs need a triggered recrawl.
- GSC: URL-prefix property `https://alphaletetrenchless.com/`. Request Indexing only through Kim-Main Chrome, about 6 to 18 per day.
- Google Ads 140-061-4219 under the TAG MCC, tag AW-17950595678 (recommend only).
- Tracking: GTM-NN7B5MDM, GA4 G-0E6QYTHXZ3 (tag GT-NFB7DLCH), WhatConverts DNI profile 171550.
- Instantly outreach key lives in the shared `.env` [redacted]; never print it.
- Images: Higgsfield, not GHL AI.

# Recurring workflows
- **Safe edit loop:** back up, assert target text appears once, edit `_elementor_data` with a guarded PHP walker and `wp_slash(wp_json_encode(...))`, delete `_elementor_css` and element cache, purge LiteSpeed per post, verify with `?cb=`, log in the Page Sheet.
- **Elementor gotchas:** close open editor tabs first; stage unpublished edits as autosaves; pix-text may render `content` rather than `content_wysiwyg`.
- **New blog:** cannibalization check, house template (question H2s, answer-first, geo FAQ, internal + official external links), `wp post create` as classic HTML (category Articles id 2, author 3), Higgsfield featured image, schedule with post_date + post_date_gmt + edit_date, set OTTO title/meta, request indexing.
- **Page Sheet refresh** and **weekly change tracker** (scheduled task Mondays about 8am). See [Alphalete - Page Sheet](lib:brain-alphalete-page-sheet).
- **Reports:** work-report skill, TAG format (TOPIC, Problem / What was done / Result, one Pending list).
- **Snippet changes:** tell the Agency owner the snippet name, edit link, line changed and revert path.

# Key IDs
- Pages: Home 3513, /services/ 5381, Residential 5408, Commercial 5434, Drain 5463, Hydro 5479, Camera 5508, /service-areas/ 5543, Contact 5554, Colorado Springs 15600, Denver 15035, Header 300, Footer 3782, Service Areas Template 13878.
- Code Snippets: #13/#14 cross-sell and service areas, #16/#19 schema, #23 service-areas overlay, #25 redirects, #26/#27 internal links, #30 /services/ lead form, #31 homepage table removal, #5 and #32 disabled.
- mu-plugins: seo-helpers, tracking-pixels, lead-form, dup-redirects, archive-cleanup, noindex-thankyou, sitemap guard.

# Local Claude config (`.claude\`)
- `launch.json` defines local preview servers: `landing-sample` (port 4321), a HyperFrames `seo-video-studio` preview, a `dashboard-preview` static server and a `shot` URL entry.
- `settings.local.json` holds a 19-entry permission allowlist (not copied).
